text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Stepping off the bus, we arrive in front of the summer training camp lodge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Intensive training at the camp, running in the Keeneland Cup... This is shaping up to be a very busy summer... however.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There are many girls who grow
significantly through summer training camp, after all...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I want to become like that too.
This summer, I'll train a lot—
choice_data_list: I'm gonna make this a refreshing summer!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it left her looking a bit dumbfounded,
it was how I truly felt, so it couldn't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Maybe I'm overthinking what comes after the Hakodate Sprint Stakes... but it doesn't hurt to err on the side of caution."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... um, that's true.
Resting is important too... isn't it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Trainer, you seem unusually full of energy today...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Do you like summer?
I think I might kinda like it too."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, I'll head to my room.
See you later.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san. Fufu... I look forward
to working with you for a while.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr!
We're rooming together this year, right?
Yeah, looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm glad. To think we'd have a chance to take our time and chat like this, as fellow classmates.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Me too. I've really been wanting
to talk to you—
